description: Foundation: additive globals.css classes (no new color token) plus the shared layout primitives everything else composes — a shared icons file, a data-driven Sidebar with the exact groups/order + DNS Firewall external item, a rebuilt TopNav (hamburger/logo/app-grid/centered [Alt+S] search/CloudShell/bell/account menu with real user fields + working Sign out), and the reusable ConsoleListPage wrapper. This feature MUST land first because FEAT-002/003/004 depend on these primitives and CSS classes. All strings/classes come from design.md.
steps: Add additive CSS to c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\app\globals.css WITHOUT rewriting any existing rule and WITHOUT adding a new color token: .btn--create (outlined-orange: background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--awsui-orange); color:var(--color-text-label); font-weight:700; hover uses --awsui-orange-hover; disabled greys border/text); .btn--outline-blue (background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--awsui-blue); color:var(--awsui-blue)); top-nav .topnav__icon-btn, .topnav__kbd ([Alt+S] badge), .topnav__menu (account dropdown), .topnav__menu-item; sidebar .sidebar__group-header (clickable row), .sidebar__chevron, .sidebar__tag-new (blue New pill), .sidebar__external (trailing arrow); console chrome .icon-btn (circular refresh/gear), .sort-indicator, .helper-line + .helper-line a, .banner + .banner--error (red); create-page .radio-card, .radio-card--selected, .radio-card__title, .radio-card__desc, .char-counter, .valid-chars, .form-actions; dashboard .dash-grid (2x2 responsive), .dash-card, .dash-card__title, .dash-card__body, .resource-list. Do NOT add #ff9900 or --awsui-orange-create. Reuse existing .info-link/.empty-state/.container-box/.toolbar/.data-table/.page-header.

Create c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\components\icons.tsx exporting pure presentational components: RefreshIcon, GearIcon, SortIcon, GridIcon (app-launcher 3x3), BellIcon, HamburgerIcon, CloudShellIcon, InfoLink (renders Info), NewTag (span.sidebar__tag-new 'New'). Inline SVG/markup, matching the current TopNav inline-SVG style.

Rewrite c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\components\Sidebar.tsx as data-driven: TOP_LINKS = Dashboard /dashboard, Hosted zones /hosted-zones, Health checks /health-checks, Profiles /profiles. GROUPS in exact order: Global Resolver [Global resolvers /global-resolvers (tag New), Shared DNS views /shared-dns-views (tag New)]; VPC Resolver [VPCs /vpcs, Inbound endpoints /inbound-endpoints, Outbound endpoints /outbound-endpoints, Rules /rules, Query logging /query-logging, Outposts /outposts]; Domains [Registered domains /registered-domains, Requests /requests]; IP-based routing [CIDR collections /cidr-collections]; Traffic flow [Traffic policies /traffic-policies, Policy records /policy-records]. DNS_FIREWALL = { label:'DNS Firewall', href:'#', external:true } rendered as a plain <a> with trailing arrow and rel="noreferrer". Groups collapsible via useState<Record<string,boolean>> keyed by group label (default all open); header is a <button className="sidebar__group-header"> with a chevron. New tags via NewTag. Keep isActive BYTE-FOR-BYTE: pathname === href || (href !== "/" && pathname.startsWith(href + "/")). No reference to /coming-soon or /resolver.

Rewrite c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\components\TopNav.tsx keeping useAuth() for user/logout. Left->right: hamburger .topnav__icon-btn (no-op), existing AWS logo SVG (keep), app-launcher GridIcon button (no-op), centered
with and right [Alt+S], .topnav__spacer, CloudShellIcon button (no-op), BellIcon button (no-op), and an account .topnav__item showing `${user?.username} @ ${user?.account_id} ▾` (guard with user?.; NO hard-coded 'First Principles'/'Sourish Das'). Clicking the account item toggles a .topnav__menu dropdown (client state) containing a Sign out .topnav__menu-item that calls logout(). Hamburger/app-grid/CloudShell/bell are visual-only.

Create c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend\src\components\ConsoleListPage.tsx implementing the design's props contract: breadcrumb: Crumb[] (reuse Breadcrumb's Crumb), title, count?, info?, description?, actions?: ConsoleAction[], showRefresh?, filterPlaceholder?, columns?: {label:string}[], emptyTitle?, emptyText?, emptyAction?, banner?: ReactNode, showPager? (default true when columns present), showGear? (default true when columns present), children?. ConsoleAction = { label; variant?: 'secondary'|'outlined-orange'; onClick?; disabled?; dropdown? }. Render: Breadcrumb, optional banner, page-header row (title + optional (N) + InfoLink; right: showRefresh icon-btn then actions), optional description, then .container-box: when columns given render toolbar (filter input + right-aligned real Pagination with page={1} pageSize={10} total={0} + gear) + .data-table head + empty state (emptyTitle/emptyText/emptyAction); when columns omitted render children. variant 'outlined-orange' uses 'btn btn--create'; 'secondary' uses 'btn'.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` in c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend exits 0 with no TypeScript errors.
A grep over frontend/src for '#ff9900' and '--awsui-orange-create' returns zero matches (no new color token added).

Sidebar.tsx contains the four top links and five groups in the exact order with the two New tags and the DNS Firewall external item, and its isActive helper is exactly `pathname === href || (href !== "/" && pathname.startsWith(href + "/"))`; it references neither /coming-soon nor /resolver.

TopNav.tsx renders the account label from user?.username and user?.account_id (no hard-coded display name) and a Sign out action calling logout(); ConsoleListPage.tsx and icons.tsx exist and export the specified members.
verification: cd c:\Users\dasso\OneDrive\Desktop\Scalar\frontend; npm run build  (expect exit 0, no TS errors)
grep -r '#ff9900' and '--awsui-orange-create' over frontend/src -> expect zero matches
findings: DONE. Build exits 0; grep for '#ff9900' and '--awsui-orange-create' over frontend/src returns zero matches. icons.tsx (@/components/icons) exports (all pure, prop-less except InfoLink): RefreshIcon, GearIcon, SortIcon, GridIcon, BellIcon, HamburgerIcon, CloudShellIcon, InfoLink (props: { href?: string } -> renders Info), NewTag (renders New). ConsoleListPage.tsx (@/components/ConsoleListPage) exports: ConsoleListPage (default-less named export), and types ConsoleColumn { label }, ConsoleAction { label; variant?: 'secondary'|'outlined-orange'; onClick?; disabled?; dropdown? }, ConsoleListPageProps. Props: breadcrumb: Crumb[] (import { Crumb } from '@/components/Breadcrumb'), title, count? (appends ' (N)' to title), info? (renders InfoLink after title), description? (rendered in a .helper-line div under the header), actions?: ConsoleAction[], showRefresh?, filterPlaceholder?, columns?: ConsoleColumn[], emptyTitle?, emptyText?, emptyAction?: ConsoleAction, banner?: ReactNode (rendered raw between Breadcrumb and page-header), showPager? (default true when columns present), showGear? (default true when columns present), children? (rendered inside .container-box only when columns omitted). outlined-orange actions use class 'btn btn--create'; secondary/default use 'btn'. Actions without onClick and not disabled render as a Next ; dropdown:true appends ' ▾'. Empty state renders inside the table body with colSpan. Pagination used with page=1 pageSize=10 total=0 (renders null for single page by design). Sidebar.tsx is data-driven (TOP_LINKS, GROUPS, DNS_FIREWALL), groups collapsible via useState keyed by group label (all open by default), chevron ▼/▶, isActive helper preserved byte-for-byte. New tags via . External DNS Firewall rendered as plain with trailing ↗. TopNav.tsx: hamburger / AWS logo (kept) / app-grid / centered .topnav__search input placeholder="Search" with .topnav__kbd [Alt+S] / spacer / CloudShell / bell / account .topnav__item showing `${user?.username} @ ${user?.account_id} ▾` inside .topnav__item-wrap; clicking toggles .topnav__menu with a Sign out .topnav__menu-item calling logout(). No hard-coded display name. New CSS classes added to globals.css (additive only, no new color token): .btn--create (outlined-orange, reuses --awsui-orange), .btn--outline-blue (reuses --awsui-blue), .topnav__icon-btn, .topnav__kbd, .topnav__item-wrap, .topnav__menu, .topnav__menu-item, .sidebar__group-header, .sidebar__chevron, .sidebar__tag-new, .sidebar__external, .icon-btn (circular refresh/gear), .sort-indicator, .helper-line (+ a), .banner, .banner--error, .radio-card, .radio-card--selected, .radio-card__title, .radio-card__desc, .char-counter, .valid-chars, .form-actions, .dash-grid (2x2 responsive), .dash-card, .dash-card__title, .dash-card__body, .resource-list. Existing tokens available: --awsui-orange #ec7211, --awsui-orange-hover #eb5f07, --awsui-blue #0972d3, --awsui-blue-hover #033160, --color-text-label #000716. Note: the old /resolver and /coming-soon routes still exist (Sidebar no longer references them). Their removal belongs to the ComingSoon-removal feature (FEAT-002/003/004), not FEAT-001.
